title: 'Chevron' label broke mid-word into a column of letters
cause: overflow-wrap: break-word splits words that do not fit the shape's text rectangle
fix: overflow-wrap: normal; word-break: keep-all (words never split, like PowerPoint); pptx harness re-run 8/8 after the round-5 run (evidence: fix-sample-shapes.pptx.desktop-dark.png)

title: A long unbreakable string in an HTML <listing> is cut at the right edge (Chromium)
cause: Author content without wrap points; the preview keeps the page's own CSS
fix: Documented: horizontal scroll inside the preview reaches it

title: WebKit: the harness's target=_top click shows no 'links cannot be opened here' bar
cause: Click event path differs in WebKit's iframe; navigation is still blocked (security checks pass)
fix: Documented; manual check on Safari recommended

title: No GIF pause button in WebKit
cause: ImageDecoder is unavailable; GIF animates natively (intended fallback)

title: Last toolbar button clipped at the right edge in window captures
cause: Crop box edge (Orca's own toolbar is clipped at the same x)
fix: Capture artifact, not a plugin defect
